content.text:
A habit name may be 1 to 100 characters, and it can't be only whitespace (R51). `description` is separate and may be at most 500 characters.

A name outside those bounds answers 422 `validation_failed` with `field: "name"`, and nothing is written (R5, R7). `scenario:habit_name_bounds` exercises this on `POST /v1/habits`.

I only saw the first part of R51's text, which was cut off after the `period` values. I can't say whether the 100 limit counts characters or bytes, or how it treats trimming. Those details may be in the rest of R51, but I haven't read it.
